analysis_scope: completed exported static evidence only; no product execution

real_capacity_correctness_guard.scope: Original real 10,000-file functional correctness guard under race; not a formal scan timing or capacity sample.

count_diagnostics.scope: One traced diagnostic sample per source/profile/phase. Work counts only; no timing, allocation, pool-wait or child-CPU comparison is derived from these samples. Raw marker values remain retained in the matrix.
count_diagnostics.transaction_scope: Confirmed AUTH committed transactions equal explicit attributed AUTH COMMIT plus implicit AUTH commits, including zero-row implicit commits. Raw BEGIN/COMMIT remain explicit client commands. Error/unconfirmed attempts and explicit rollbacks remain separate. Single-row responses are not proof of final Go authorization grants.

limits: Catalog-cold is not physically cold storage.
Three matched source blocks do not establish stable tail latency.
SQL-traced diagnostics are work-count observations excluded from acceptance timings.
Disabled SQL counters are uncollected/null rather than measured zero.
The bounded profiles do not qualify whole-service, existing players, GPU/native hard resources, PART2 or mixed capacity.
Process MemStats and pool deltas include observer/runtime work; diagnostics also include tracer work.
The visible closure audit is not a claim about every global kernel resource.

preparation-receipt.scope: Optional separate preparation file used by the prior batch; not produced or required by this batch. The actual setup receipt is the lifecycle input.

supporting_evidence.seal_export_scope: All selected raw logs, manifests and receipts must be exported and match. Other remote sealed artifacts, including optional build binaries, retain exported/not_exported references without being treated as local runtime evidence.
